status: Targeted selector interaction host migration; full matrices reserved for larger blocks.

snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
snapshot.method: Frozen UI overlay base a3afc206f742f0a59da6e65d609ddf1df3c7326d plus 16 explicit live UI overrides (including sidebar_metal.h/mm), with committed own installer/stager hooks; concurrent network-policy changes excluded. Twenty-one prototype source hashes are matched to committed, live and staged inputs.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

build_scope.limit: Current-main network policy excluded from this frozen UI-lab binary and acceptance.

contracts: SceneSelect now derives from plain View RustActionView instead of SceneGlyphButton/Button. Preference, tools, profile and import selectors construct no Button/ButtonController instances on their Rust paths. Native comparison retains Combobox/PreferenceCombobox.

Existing Rust SelectState still owns selected keys, prefix matching, empty selection, model replacement and generation tokens. Native PrefixSelector/IME protocol, font/theme/measurement adapters, native menu services and existing domain callbacks remain.

Rust ActionControl now owns selector pointer/gesture, enabled/focused/visual state and capture cancellation. Existing Rust select_menu_key preserves Mac menu-key admission. The selector activation override retains its prior menu-only notification policy.

AX open verbs disappear while disabled and restore on enable; value, expanded/collapsed, role and popup metadata remain. Disabled state still dismisses the native menu; hide/model/profile cancellation retains the original SelectState token policy.

Scheduling synchronously cancels clipped pointer input before GPU coalescing. The new shared test opens and cancels real Chromium Views popup menus through AX, Down and mouse paths and checks live expanded state and collapsed state after cancel in both modes, unchanged value, reference-versus-Rust host types and disable/re-enable verbs. A Rust-only branch scrolls an armed selector out/back and verifies late release does not open a menu.

Existing physical Cocoa prefix typing, empty selection, durable preference/site policy, tools drafts/history/restore, profile stable IDs, import menu and async callbacks retain their assertions. No dependency or browser admission/store/persistence policy change.

previous_full_checkpoint.scope: The previous full checkpoint predates appearance and select-host changes. This source has targeted acceptance only.

remaining: Pointer activation phase parity remains open: native Combobox opens on mouse press; SceneSelect retains its previous prototype release activation. This ownership migration does not claim identical pointer phase policy.
Remaining decorative/glyph Button controls, native per-control View identity, stable Rust nodes, containers/placement, Views popup/menu ownership and UI coordination remain open.
Manual hardware trackpad, IME candidates, VoiceOver, global RTL, scale/theme and GPU recovery remain open.
Current-main combined network policy and final shipped dependency/license/notice acceptance remain outside this frozen UI lab.
probe_diagnosis: The first probe failed only the new popup case in each mode: it incorrectly used the Cocoa NSMenu inspector, while COMBOBOX routes to Views MenuController. The second used that controller: Metal passed; Views failed only mouse re-open because ArrowButtonPressed guards rapid clicks after close. The third exercises mouse first: Metal passed; Views opened its popup but RootView returned false because opening on press clears its capture handler. The final fixture ignores that capture return and asserts the actual live controller, expanded/collapsed/value and menu outcomes. Production code was unchanged after the probes.
gpu_log_diagnostics_note: Raw nonfatal compositor diagnostic counts remain unresolved and do not establish performance gains.
